text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After my outing with Hishi Akebono, I was 
handed a planetarium flyer in front of the 
station. Apparently, an expert in 
space-related industries is narrating 
today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We get to hear stories about the stars and 
space! Oh, there's even a discount coupon 
on the flyer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Sounds like fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~!? Akebono, yahoo-marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! What a coincidence! Did you come 
to look at the stars too, Marvelous-chan?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right☆ We're searching for 
sparkling Marvelous★!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hope you find something marvelous. Ah, 
looks like it's starting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A starry sky spreads across the domed 
ceiling. Along with explanations of the 
projected constellations, the structure of 
stars and galaxies is narrated in detail.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There sure are an incredible number of 
stars in space~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what do aliens eat, I wonder? 
Would they eat Earth food, you think~?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Heh... There are actually people who 
believe in aliens?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
You're totally buying into sci-fi movies, 
aren't you? Man, you're so pure.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're right... If you haven't seen it 
with your own eyes, it's only natural you 
wouldn't believe it~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There are several terrestrial planets 
located in the habitable zone of the Milky 
Way galaxy! Those planets might even 
possess water.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"It's an environment where living 
organisms could easily exist! Space is 
still full of mysteries and unknown 
possibilities! It's marvelous☆ 
Space-marvelous★☆"

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: H-Hey... let's go...

text_block_list.name: Astronomy & Space Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad you've taken an interest in 
outer space. If you'd like, I can answer 
your earlier question.

text_block_list.name: Astronomy & Space Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what aliens eat, but... maybe 
they'd enjoy Earth food.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then I'd love to eat chanko nabe 
together~!

text_block_list.name: Astronomy & Space Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hot pot... might be a bit tricky. In zero 
gravity, the ingredients and broth would 
scatter everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What?! The ingredients and broth are all 
separate...?

text_block_list.name: Astronomy & Space Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That's why liquid space food is thickened. 
So that surface tension keeps it together.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What's space food like? Is it tasty? Is it 
marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Astronomy & Space Commentator
text_block_list.text:
I think it tastes a lot better now. So 
many people have been doing research 
because they want astronauts to have 
delicious food.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ Just like with Akebono! She 
makes everyone marvelous with delicious 
food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're right. So even space food is made 
with the desire to give people something 
delicious to eat, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Now I really wanna learn more about space 
food!"
choice_data_list: Let's buy some space food and try it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wah! I want to try making 'Space Chanko'!!

text_block_list.name: Astronomy & Space Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, watching videos of 
astronauts eating space food might be 
helpful. They give taste reviews too, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of the break, I decided 
to watch the astronaut video. Since it has 
subtitles, it's great that I can watch it 
in places like this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, water splits apart like that?! So 
that's what breaking the broth apart 
meant!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~? Even upside down, nothing spills 
from the can! Marvelous!! But it won't mix 
properly, will it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Since there's zero gravity, everything 
just floats and won't mix together~ 
Cooking in space seems super hard!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The astronaut is saying they're so 
happy to have Japanese food... They said 
meals are their biggest joy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...It'd be nice if we could eat hot pot, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna come up with a recipe for Space 
Chanko! If I stream making it on 
Umastagram, it might even help with space 
food development!"
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ Let's do it, let's do it!★ 
Let's deliver chanko nabe to the cosmos☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I hope astronauts and aliens can all 
gather around a chanko pot together 
someday~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! They even sell space 
food in the souvenir corner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bought some space food packs of curry 
and rice, plus chicken simmered in miso, 
and decided to head back to the academy to 
try them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well then, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Curry rice, marvelous☆ It has a super 
spicy flavor★

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The chicken simmered in miso is quite rich 
too. Looks like the broth has been 
thickened~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because one's sense of taste changes in a 
zero-gravity environment, space food is 
apparently seasoned more intensely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems other measures have also been 
taken to protect the astronauts' health, 
such as reducing sodium and boosting 
nutritional value.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Space food is made with so much thought 
put into it, huh. All for the sake of the 
astronauts...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
She must have worked so, so hard to 
achieve this flavor...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Delicious" is simply marvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. "Deliciousness" isn't just about the 
taste... It really reminded me that I 
shouldn't forget that either.
